purpose: 2.0 companion Skill design; selected practices, not a standards certification or competitor benchmark
readingBoundary: Sources reviewed through public documentation and repository pages. Summaries are paraphrased; no community implementation code copied. Vendor and protocol versions are reference contexts, not a claim about the installed product.
